name: com.smart.library.util.accessibility.STActivityTrackerService$Companion$ActivityTrackerBroadcastReceiver
description: When a user taps the Smart Library debug notification's accessibility shortcut, this receiver checks whether activity tracking is enabled; if it is not, it opens Android Accessibility settings.
disableEffect: The debug notification's shortcut will no longer take users to Accessibility settings; regular app screens are unaffected.
